description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Defaults' which renders user preference settings related to application defaults, such as spellcheck, confirmation dialogs on Android, and nested note folder options. It manages state, interacts with the application via provided methods, and uses various imported components for UI elements.

methods.name: toggleSpellcheck
methods.description: Toggles the spellcheck preference and calls the application's method to toggle global spellcheck.

methods.name: toggleAndroidConfirmBeforeExit
methods.description: Toggles the confirmation dialog before exiting the app on Android.
